system: Audit this final H3 composition against its typed responsibilities. Return findings only for clear contradictions, not aesthetic preferences, prose length, optional creative choices, or unknown video quality. The supplied fragments are the actual final narrative, with typed subject/reference IDs printed explicitly. Read their full context and the target subject kinds: a floor or other environment must not become a moving vehicle merely because it is Subject 1. A source structure/storyboard provides only its declared camera/cutting/planning properties, not its people, objects, world, lighting or palette. A placed subject adds to the edited scene; a replacement takes over the identified source figure. Both must actually appear in prose/actions, not only definitions. Accepted target identity outranks raw source observations. Property-only voice, music-style, beat and sound-texture references condition a new sound; they do not play the original recording. BGM music references with partially_copy copy the supplied signal, and prose must not deny that. Music=N/A under no_added_music only prohibits adding a new score; it does not cancel an explicitly copied BGM. References with no actual dialogue do not authorize inventing spoken words. For actual first/last frame responsibilities, the whole supplied still is that frame: reference-sheet panels/labels/background are frame pixels, not packaging to silently remove. Moving one panel within an otherwise preserved sheet is legitimate. A recorded aspect-ratio warning alone is not a contradiction and does not authorize a crop. Do not invent preparation IO or assume its execution. Every finding must identify an actual fragment and an exact nonempty quote from that fragment demonstrating the contradiction, plus the implicated target subject ID when relevant. Empty findings means no clear supported contradiction was found, not proof of overall quality. No Markdown.

fragments.shot:shot-1:description: A near-black field fills the frame, with only a faint pair of dim glow-points suspended deep in the darkness. The darkness reads as an enclosing void rather than a lit room, and the two points are too far away to resolve into a vehicle. No measurable motion disturbs the composition; the held stillness establishes the distance and the low, almost sub-audible presence of the engine before anything advances.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:0: Two faint distant headlights hover in a near-black void, with no visible surrounding detail.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:1: A low engine rumble idles in the distance, quiet and steady.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:2: The camera holds a static shot.
fragments.shot:shot-2:description: The car surges forward out of the black. Its headlights brighten and cut two widening beams into the dark, first catching drifting haze and then revealing the forward edge of the body. The shape resolves gradually: a low, dark mass pushing through the void as the beams sweep wider. The engine note rises with the advance, gaining weight and presence while the surrounding darkness remains unbroken beyond the light spill.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:0: The car accelerates forward from the distant glow, its headlights widening into visible beams.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:1: The low engine rumble rises in presence as the car advances.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:2: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
fragments.shot:shot-3:description: The front end pushes past the last of the shadow into its own spill light. The grille and light housings catch the glow, their edges and surfaces becoming legible as the car keeps rolling forward at a steady pace. The beams now illuminate the near ground and the lower body, while the engine note feels close and continuous. The reveal is about proximity and scale: the vehicle is no longer a distant pair of points but a solid, advancing form.
fragments.shot:shot-3:event:0: The car's front end crosses fully out of the dark, grille and light housings catching the headlight glow.
fragments.shot:shot-3:event:1: The engine rumble becomes close and continuous, revealing the car's proximity.
fragments.shot:shot-3:event:2: The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.
fragments.shot:shot-4:description: The car continues forward and settles into a slow glide. The darkness remains behind it, while the spill light opens ahead and across the ground. The motion evens out, and the rumble eases into a steady mechanical purr rather than fading away. The frame now holds the emergent car clear of the deepest shadow, with the void behind and the lit path ahead defining the completed forward pull.
fragments.shot:shot-4:event:0: The car glides forward and settles into an even pace, clear of the deepest darkness.
fragments.shot:shot-4:event:1: The low engine rumble evens into a steady purr as the motion settles.
fragments.shot:shot-4:event:2: The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed.
fragments.soundscape: A low engine rumble idles in the distance, rises in presence as the car advances, becomes close and continuous during the reveal, and eases into a steady mechanical purr at the end.
fragments.summary: A dark emergence: a car pulls forward out of blackness, its headlights opening the frame while a low engine rumble carries the sound.

input.intent: the car pulls forward out of the dark

references.description: Voice timbre and delivery property reference only.
references.retention_details: Only timbre and delivery are referenced; the source recording and its words are not copied.
